notes.title: Patch 0.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Upgraded the game from Unreal Engine 4 to [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b] version.
[*] Updated the first campaign mission
[*] [b]Updated all game systems[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Single- and Multiplayer Matches[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40936269/3443aa07009e94543c78d8eb0aba8a9c83f56716.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Server infrastructure change from AWS (Amazon) to EOS (Epic Games) - code adapted / implemented.
[*] Players can create matches, or join existing matches.
[/list]
The new server environment Epic Online Services (EOS) by Epic Games  is not yet full functional.

[h2]Campaign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40936269/3443aa07009e94543c78d8eb0aba8a9c83f56716.png[/img]
The first campaign mission map has been reworked, it's now a single level. 

Controls:
E - Pickup items
Right mouse button: Zoom

[h2]Upcoming patches[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40936269/3443aa07009e94543c78d8eb0aba8a9c83f56716.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Next updates will complete existing content modifications.
[*] Continuation of campaign development. 
[/list]

Expect more frequent updates in the weeks ahead.

notes.title: Space Alpha Patch 0.7.1
notes.content:
Enabled Steam.

[b]MAP: SPACE STATION[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved lightning
[*] Fixed a bug with some spawns
[*] Addressed an issue with foot height, causing blocked AI
[*] Replaced the spaceship with a smaller one
[/list]

[b]MAP: PLANETARY BASE[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed: The large doors in the center of the map having no collision 
[*] Reduced the lightning intensity of the lamps

[/list]

Multiplayer will likely become available in the next update.

notes.title: Space Alpha Patch 0.7
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Overhaul of many game systems
[*] Addition of new campaign / mission game mode
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40936269/f8de6cf4c5b8a4e5dcb5922674a73f4c1342f0d9.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Different skill level for bots, can be configured on match making.
[*] The new campaign / mission system can currently be play tested, the first level. Upcoming updates will add more levels and objectives.
[/list]

The new campaign mode will be extended from here on, including player progression. 

[h1]CAMPAIGN MODE KEY BINDINGS[/h1]
I - Inventory
P - Menu
M - Objective panel
TAB - Toggle 1st and 3rd person view

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40936269/c774fe1899a128765384ad069064f0e9539507a5.jpg[/img]

[h1]ADDRESSED IN NEXT UPDATE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer is still disabled, will be enabled later this month.
[*] There is currently an issue with music not playing, or not properly, in which case you can disable the music from the settings menu (ESC key).
[*] Bots are currently not properly setup on the CTF map.
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Update build Alpha 0.6.2 fixed an issue with player sessions.

[list]
[*] Players are now properly removed from games, game player numbers reflect now the actual player amount.
[/list]

When we upload a new build servers are approximately 1 hour offline.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Patch 0.6.1 integrates the main parts for multiplayer gameplay. However, not all things work yet properly. This patch introduces a major game feature still under construction.

This patch includes:
- Basic multiplayer gameplay features.
- Currently only the Planetary Base map is working in multiplayer.

Notice that the current server is likely not optimal for best performance - this also requires testing once all multiplayer features and gameplay are ready.
 
The next patches will fix the doors on the Planetary Base map (currently you can walk through them), fix the player rotation, and add the Space Station map.

[b]Note [/b]
The current server is located in Germany, Frankfurt. Once multiplayer is fully integrated more server locations will become available, specifically in the U.S. and Asia.
The server may be unavailable from time to time as new game builds are tested.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
This patch includes the following updates:

[list]
[*] Default video settings have been changed from max settings, to high.
[*] Default framerate has been set to 30 fps, instead of max. You can change it to 60 fps, or disable the feature, which sets the framerate to the maximum setting. Under maximum settings the game will use all available GPU power.
[*] Fixed the recently displaced stairs on the Planetary map.
[/list]

Change the default framerate from the Settings – video panel, or via the in-game menu by pressing the ESC key.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40936269/ee013bd3e38d10d21af3de2056d7f1490676497a.png[/img]
[b]What to expect from Early Access?[/b]

With the start of Early Access we will begin tweaking various multiplayer features. In the days ahead expect frequent updates, and the possibility that some game features may not work properly. In case you encounter an issue post it at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1487750/discussions/]Community Discussion Board[/url].

[b]The state of the game[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 Maps
[*] Play with bots and or other players.
[/list]

While basic gameplay is available in Early Access we plan major changes affecting almost all game features. This includes existing maps, characters, weapons, sounds, and settings.

For the latest updates follow us at [url=https://twitter.com/SpaceAlpha]Twitter[/url], or on [url=https://discord.gg/eP4FcnXCSx]Discord[/url].
